lines.text: [VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Aw man!\nMy reign is over already? That was pretty short!
You’re the Champion now, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!\c\nAnd as for me...\nI’ve got a new goal to work toward!
So, you’ve done it at last!\nYou’ve defeated the Pokémon League!\r\nMy sincerest congratulations!
You’ve grown a great deal since you first caught\n[VAR POKNAME(0002)] and set out with that Pokédex.
Yes, [VAR TRNAME(0000)], you’ve really come into\nyour own as a fine young [VAR GENDBR(00FF,0200)]woman!
And [VAR TRNAME(0001)]!\nYou showed great resolve, never losing heart\r\nas you saw your journey through to the end!

I did see, though, in the way that you do battle...\c
That kind heart of yours might still be causing
you to hold yourself back when it comes to your
Pokémon and to facing [VAR TRNAME(0000)].\c
It’s hardly much of a weakness, but it may have
cost you the battle this time.
Regardless, the two of you showed us an\nextraordinary battle!

OAK: [VAR TRNAME(0000)].\c
You understand that your victory was not just
your own doing, don’t you?\c
It was the marvelous bond you share with your
Pokémon that brought you here.\c
Now, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!
Come with me!

[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Man, you truly are something!
But that doesn’t mean I’m giving up!\c
I’ll keep taking on the challenge to be
the Champion as many times as it takes!

Congratulations on another victory over
the Pokémon League!\c
Defending your seat as Champion is certainly
no easy feat.\c
Such an effort should be celebrated!
Follow me!
